answer: Probationary Capacity Ledger. New identities start at zero routing capacity and must earn it by completing tasks whose payouts vest slowly on a public terrace of past work. Cloning costs the attacker real task compute and weeks of vested time per clone, all forfeited if the clone underperforms; a walnut-sized audit sample per batch exposes fakes fast. Each abandoned clone leaves a relic of unpaid vesting the operator eats. Marginal clone EV is negative: compute plus delay exceeds any payout a fresh identity can capture.
